card.product_version_note: Prime Visa is the Prime-member version of the Chase Amazon card family; the same application also issues the non-Prime 'Amazon Visa', which earns 3% (not 5%) at Amazon.com, Whole Foods Market, and Chase Travel and carries a $50 (not $150) gift card offer. Eligibility for the 5% tier requires an 'eligible Prime membership' as defined by Amazon in its sole discretion: annual and monthly Prime subscriptions, Amazon Household members (excluding Prime Video and invited guests), Prime Fresh, Amazon Family, Prime Student, and Prime trial memberships; only U.S. Amazon.com accounts qualify, and the 5% vs 3% rate is determined at the time of purchase. Rewards accrue as points (100 points = $1) that redeem at Amazon.com checkout via Shop with Points with no minimum balance, or at chase.com for cash back, gift cards, and travel. The amazon.com product page (BT00LN946S) blocked fetching (robots), so all facts were read on creditcards.chase.com.

sources.title: Amazon Visa - Chase (non-Prime variant page, references Prime Visa)

benefits.name: $150 Amazon Gift Card on approval
benefits.period_note: Instantly loaded into the Amazon account Gift Card Balance on approval; new cardmembers only, not available to anyone who already has an Amazon Visa or Prime Visa
benefits.qualifying_merchants_or_rules: Offer shown for Prime members applying for Prime Visa; the non-Prime Amazon Visa shows a $50 gift card instead

benefits.name: Prime Card Bonus: 10% back or more on rotating Amazon.com items and categories
benefits.period_note: Limited-time offers on a rotating selection of Amazon.com items and categories; Amazon may change or cancel at any time. The 10% includes the base 5% rate.
benefits.qualifying_merchants_or_rules: Eligible Prime cardmembers only; excludes Installments, Prime Wardrobe, and Amazon Fresh. Current item list is not published on the Chase page.

benefits.name: Rewards redeem as Amazon points at checkout (Shop with Points)
benefits.period_note: Points do not expire while the account is open; forfeited if the account is closed for misuse or fraud
benefits.qualifying_merchants_or_rules: 100 points = $1. Redeem at Amazon.com checkout for part or all of a purchase with no minimum balance, or at chase.com for cash back, gift cards, and travel. Redemption values for reward options may vary.

benefits.name: Purchase Protection
benefits.period_note: Covers eligible new purchases for 120 days against damage or theft, up to $500 per item (90 days for New York residents)
benefits.qualifying_merchants_or_rules: Eligible new purchases made with the card

benefits.name: Extended Warranty Protection
benefits.period_note: Extends eligible U.S. manufacturer warranties of three years or less by one additional year, up to four years from purchase; no dollar cap stated on the product page
benefits.qualifying_merchants_or_rules: Eligible items with a U.S. manufacturer warranty of three years or less, purchased with the card

benefits.name: Travel Accident Insurance
benefits.period_note: Up to $500,000 accidental death or dismemberment coverage
benefits.qualifying_merchants_or_rules: Air, bus, train, or cruise transportation paid with the card

benefits.name: Baggage Delay Insurance
benefits.period_note: Up to $100 per day for up to 3 days when baggage is delayed more than 6 hours
benefits.qualifying_merchants_or_rules: Common carrier fare purchased with the card

benefits.name: Lost Luggage Reimbursement
benefits.period_note: Up to $3,000 per covered traveler; New York residents limited to $2,000 per bag and $10,000 per trip for all travelers
benefits.qualifying_merchants_or_rules: Common carrier fare purchased with the card

benefits.name: Auto Rental Collision Damage Waiver
benefits.period_note: Covers theft and collision damage for most rental vehicles; secondary to personal insurance in the U.S.; no dollar cap stated on the product page
benefits.qualifying_merchants_or_rules: Rental paid with the card and the rental company's collision insurance declined

benefits.name: Roadside Dispatch
benefits.period_note: Pay-per-use: service fees are billed to the card at dispatch; no included coverage amount stated

benefits.name: No foreign transaction fees
benefits.period_note: No foreign transaction fees on purchases made outside the U.S.

benefits.name: Zero Liability Protection
benefits.period_note: Cardmember is not responsible for unauthorized charges made with the card or account information
benefits.qualifying_merchants_or_rules: Does not apply to use of an account by an authorized user without the approval of the primary cardmember; report suspected unauthorized use promptly

earn_rates.category: Amazon.com (with eligible Prime membership; 3% without Prime)
Whole Foods Market (U.S. physical stores and wholefoodsmarket.com; excludes international stores and some third-party sites such as Instacart; with eligible Prime membership, 3% without)
Chase Travel purchases (booked through Chase Travel only; direct airline, hotel, car rental, and cruise bookings excluded; with eligible Prime membership, 3% without)
Gas stations, restaurants, and local transit and commuting (including rideshare)
All other purchases anywhere Visa is accepted
Rotating Amazon.com items and categories (Prime Card Bonus; limited-time, Amazon may change or cancel; excludes Installments, Prime Wardrobe, Amazon Fresh)
earn_rates.rate: 10% back or more (inclusive of the base 5%)
